## What's included
- `GAM_Command_Bank.exe`: standalone Windows app
- `commands.json`: the built-in library, for importing into the web version or another copy
- `GAM_Command_Bank_Web.zip`: the web version

To upgrade, replace the old exe with this one. Your commands, favorites and settings stay as they are.

## What's new in v4.1.0
**Looks like its own app now**
- The app's own icon now shows in the taskbar, Alt+Tab and every window, instead of the Python/Tk feather. The icon is redrawn so it's sharp at every size and display scaling.
- The app has its own taskbar identity, and Task Manager and the file's Properties show "GAM Command Bank" with version details.
- The title bar follows the app theme: dark in dark mode, and matching the app colours on Windows 11.
- The grey Windows menu bar is replaced by an in-app menu bar in the header, with themed drop-down menus. Alt+F / E / V / R / H or F10 open the menus from the keyboard.
- Confirmations and messages use themed dialogs instead of the standard Windows message boxes. The Run confirmation shows the exact command, and Cancel is selected by default.
- The window no longer flashes white on startup.

**Also**
- The search box resizes with the window
- Every pull request now builds a test exe you can download from the Actions run
